msg: Two WebSocket clients (conn A, B) on the shared daemon's Unix control socket (~/.codex/app-server-control/app-server-control.sock, app-server 0.166.0). B resumes A's loaded thread and receives A's turn events; B starts a turn, A receives it.

params.name: alpha_mcp
params.error: The alpha_mcp MCP server requires OAuth reauthentication. Run `codex mcp login alpha_mcp`.
